# P Travels Demo by P-Devs

> Interactive portfolio demo of a responsive Philippine travel showcase.

## Canonical URL

- [Open the demo](https://travels-demo.pauuu.dev/)
- [Visit the P-Devs portfolio](https://pauuu.dev/)

## Demo behavior

- Destinations, packages, prices, and booking details are fictional portfolio content.
- Visitor-entered data resets every day at 12:00 AM Asia/Manila.
- Do not enter real or sensitive information.
